## Spatial concentration

@fig-spatial-concentration-bar compares the share of primary residences and contact venues across community districts. Within each borough, a few districts were over-represented among contact venues relative to where participants lived—specifically BK01 (Williamsburg–Greenpoint), MN05 (Midtown), and QN05 (Ridgewood). These hotspots mark the city’s social centers: where people converged for nightlife, group gatherings, and sexual contact, amplifying both community connection and opportunities for transmission.



```{r }
#| fig-cap: Difference between the proportion of primary residences and contact venues in each community district, highlighting areas over-represented among venues.
#| label: fig-spatial-concentration-bar
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

make_plotdata_spatial_concentration_bar() |>
  plot_home_vs_residence_dbn_bar() +
  scale_alpha_mpxnyc() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "Borough", option = "dark") +
  scale_axis_mpxnyc() +
  theme_mpxnyc_home_vs_place() 


```
